readme:
## Overview

This module provides file read/write APIs and console print/read APIs. The file APIs allow read and write operations on different kinds of file types such as bytes, text, CSV, JSON, and XML. Further, these file APIs can be categorized as streaming and non-streaming APIs.

The following diagram depicts the overview architecture of the I/O package.

![Architecture Diagram](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ballerina-platform/module-ballerina-io/master/ballerina/docs/architecture.svg)

The file I/O operations can be categorized further based on the serialization and deserialization types such as:
- Bytes I/O
- Strings I/O
- CSV I/O
- JSON I/O
- XML I/O

### Console I/O
The console I/O APIs, which help you to read from the console as well as write to the console are as follows.
- `io:print`
- `io:println`
- `io:readln`

### Bytes I/O
The bytes I/O APIs provide the reading and writing APIs in both streaming and non-streaming ways. Those APIs are,
- `io:fileReadBytes`
- `io:fileReadBlocksAsStream`
- `io:fileWriteBytes`
- `io:fileWriteBlocksFromStream`

### Strings I/O
The strings I/O APIs provide the reading and writing APIs in 3 different ways:
1. Read the complete file content as a string and write a given string to a file
2. Read the complete file content as a set of lines and write a given set of lines to a file
3. Read the complete file content as a stream of lines and write a given stream of lines to a file

The strings I/O APIs are as follows:
- `io:fileReadString`
- `io:fileReadLines`
- `io:fileReadLinesAsStream`
- `io:fileWriteLines`
- `io:fileWriteLinesFromStream`

### CSV I/O
The CSV I/O APIs provide the reading and writing APIs in both streaming and non-streaming ways. Those APIs are:
- `io:fileReadCsv`
- `io:fileReadCsvAsStream`
- `io:fileWriteCsv`
- `io:fileWriteCsvFromStream`

### JSON I/O
The JSON I/O APIs provide the reading and writing APIs for JSON content. Those APIs are:
- `io:fileReadJson`
- `io:fileWriteJson`

### XML I/O
The XML I/O APIs provide the reading and writing APIs for XML content. Those APIs are:
- `io:fileReadXml`
- `io:fileWriteXml`

functions.name: init

functions.name: read
functions.description:
Reads bytes from a given input resource.
This operation will be asynchronous in which the total number of required bytes might not be returned at a given
time. An `io:EofError` will return once the channel reaches the end.
```ballerina
byte[]|io:Error result = readableByteChannel.read(1000);
```

parameters.name: nBytes
parameters.description: Represents the number of bytes, which should be read. This should be a positive integer.

return.description: Content (the number of bytes) read, an `EofError` once the channel reaches the end or else an `io:Error`

functions.name: readAll
functions.description:
Reads all content of the channel as a `byte` array and return a read only `byte` array.
```ballerina
byte[]|io:Error result = readableByteChannel.readAll();
```

return.description: A read-only `byte` array or else an `io:Error`

functions.name: blockStream
functions.description:
Returns a block stream that can be used to read all `byte` blocks as a stream.
```ballerina
stream<io:Block, io:Error>|io:Error result = readableByteChannel.blockStream();
```

parameters.name: blockSize
parameters.description: The size of the block. This should be a positive integer.

return.description: A block stream or else an `io:Error`

functions.name: base64Encode
functions.description:
Encodes a given `io:ReadableByteChannel` using the Base64 encoding scheme.
```ballerina
io:ReadableByteChannel|Error encodedChannel = readableByteChannel.base64Encode();
```

return.description: An encoded `io:ReadableByteChannel` or else an `io:Error`

functions.name: base64Decode
functions.description:
Decodes a given Base64 encoded `io:ReadableByteChannel`.
```ballerina
io:ReadableByteChannel|Error encodedChannel = readableByteChannel.base64Decode();
```

return.description: A decoded `io:ReadableByteChannel` or else an `io:Error`

functions.name: close
functions.description:
Closes the readable byte channel to release any underlying resources.
After a channel is closed, any further reading operations will cause an error.
```ballerina
io:Error? err = readableByteChannel.close();
```

return.description: `()` or else an `io:Error` if any error occurred

typeDefs.description: Initializes a readable character channel.

functions.name: read
functions.description:
Reads a given number of characters. This will attempt to read up to the `numberOfChars` characters of the channel.
An `io:EofError` will return once the channel reaches the end.
```ballerina
string|io:Error result = readableCharChannel.read(1000);
```

parameters.name: numberOfChars
parameters.description: Number of characters, which should be read

return.description:
The characters that read as a string, an `io:EofError` once the channel reaches the end, or else an
`io:Error` if something went wrong while reading

functions.name: readString
functions.description:
Reads the entire channel content as a string.
```ballerina
string|io:Error content = readableCharChannel.readString();
```

return.description: The content that read as a string or an `io:Error`

functions.name: readAllLines
functions.description:
Reads the entire channel content as a list of lines.
```ballerina
string[]|io:Error content = readableCharChannel.readAllLines();
```

return.description: The content that read as an array of lines (separated by the `\n` character) or an `io:Error`

functions.name: readJson
functions.description:
Reads a JSON from the given channel.
```ballerina
json|io:Error result = readableCharChannel.readJson();
```

return.description: The content that is read as a JSON or else an `io:Error`

functions.name: readXml
functions.description:
Reads an XML from the given channel.
```ballerina
json|io:Error result = readableCharChannel.readXml();
```

return.description: The content that is read as an XML or else an `io:Error`

functions.name: readProperty
functions.description:
Reads the value of a specified property key from a properties file.
If the key is not found, the provided default value is returned.
```ballerina
string|io:Error result = readableCharChannel.readProperty(key, defaultValue);
```

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The property key to look up in the properties file

parameters.name: defaultValue
parameters.description: The default value to return if the key is not found

return.description: The property value related to the given key or else an `io:Error`

functions.name: lineStream
functions.description:
Returns a stream of lines that can be used to read all the lines in a file as a stream.
```ballerina
stream<string, io:Error>|io:Error? result = readableCharChannel.lineStream();
```

return.description: A stream of strings (lines) or an `io:Error`

functions.name: readAllProperties
functions.description:
Reads all properties from a properties file.
```ballerina
map<string>|io:Error result = readableCharChannel.readAllProperties();
```

return.description: A map of strings that contains all properties

typeDefs.name: Format
typeDefs.description:
Specifies the format used to represent CSV data.

DEFAULT - The default value is the format specified by the CSVChannel. Precedence will be given to the field
separator and record separator.

CSV - Field separator will be "," and the record separator will be a new line.

TDF - Field separator will be a tab and the record separator will be a new line.

typeDefs.name: Separator
typeDefs.description:
Field separators, which are supported by the `DelimitedTextRecordChannel`.

COMMA - Delimited text records will be separated using a comma

TAB - Delimited text records will be separated using a tab

COLON - Delimited text records will be separated using a colon(:)

typeDefs.name: Error
typeDefs.description: Represents IO module related errors.

typeDefs.name: ConnectionTimedOutError
typeDefs.description: This will return when connection timed out happen when try to connect to a remote host.

typeDefs.name: GenericError
typeDefs.description: Represents generic IO error. The detail record contains the information related to the error.

typeDefs.name: AccessDeniedError
typeDefs.description: This will get returned due to file permission issues.

typeDefs.name: FileNotFoundError
typeDefs.description: This will get returned if the file is not available in the given file path.

typeDefs.name: TypeMismatchError
typeDefs.description: This will get returned when there is an mismatch of given type and the expected type.

typeDefs.name: EofError
typeDefs.description: This will get returned if read operations are performed on a channel after it closed.

typeDefs.name: ConfigurationError
typeDefs.description: This will get returned if there is an invalid configuration.

typeDefs.name: FileWriteOption
typeDefs.description: Represents a file opening options for writing.

typeDefs.name: XmlEntityType

typeDefs.name: XmlDoctype

typeDefs.description: Represents the writing options of an XML.

fields.name: xmlEntityType

fields.name: doctype

typeDefs.name: PrintableRawTemplate
typeDefs.description:
Represents raw templates.
e.g: `The respective int value is ${val}`

typeDefs.name: Printable
typeDefs.description:
Defines all the printable types.
1. any typed value
2. errors
3. `io:PrintableRawTemplate` - an raw templated value

typeDefs.name: FileOutputStream

Defines the output streaming types.

typeDefs.name: ByteOrder
typeDefs.description:
Represents network byte order.

BIG_ENDIAN - specifies the bytes to be in the order of most significant byte first.

LITTLE_ENDIAN - specifies the byte order to be the least significant byte first.
